title: Hearing, subpoena.
bodyText: For the purpose of any investigation or proceeding, the commissioner or any person designated by the commissioner may hold hearings subject to chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §435E-44  Hearing, subpoena.  For the purpose of any investigation or proceeding, the commissioner or any person designated by the commissioner may hold hearings subject to chapter 91. [L 1977, c 182, pt of §1; am L 1982, c 203, §16; gen ch 1985]
